The structure of K₂CrF₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula of K₈Cr₄F₂₄, 36 atoms per unit cell, and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six F neighbors, while K centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 F neighbors. Cr octahedra share corners, and K-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra share corners and faces with Cr octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 36 sites.
